none: PAS HESH-A16725: Roman As of the Emperor Trajan (98-117 AD).
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman As of the Emperor Trajan (98-117 AD). On the obverse (heads) is the laurate bust of the emperor with ass associated legend: IMP CAES NERVA TRAIAN AVG GERM PM. The reverse (tails) has a Victory (winged figure) flying left holding palm in the right hand and shield in left. The reverse inscription reads TR POT COS [] PP SC
